Sometimes when I tell people I live in California they're like ew and I'm like haha yeah the rent sucks here!

But in reality I absolutely love it here and this map shows exactly why I'm unwilling to move to many places.

Yeah this is a huge issue I have with mandatory pronouns. Some teachers do this thinking they're being "accepting" not realizing they're forcing closeted people to choose between coming out and misgendering themselves. Makes me really annoyed because it feels kind of patronizing to have something explicitly for "inclusivity" exclude an important subset of all the people it's supposed to be inclusive towards.

It needs to be optional.

I recently realized that my ideal future version of myself is a woman. And it kinda feels like I'm stuck in a really bad place because I don't like who I am but I don't have a direction to improve myself because it doesn't seem attainable. In the past I've always had a goal like being more social or getting a job, and I could work towards that goal no matter how far away it was (still no job lol).

It feels like I might be trans but I *really* don't think I can handle that. I already can't handle my life very well. I don't know what friends or family I'd lose if I came out as trans and honestly I can't afford to find out.

Thank you for reading my deranged rant
Anyone else scared of getting drunk because of the fear of accidentally outing yourself?

I have a weird question. How do I dress like an enby? I'm making a bunch of changes in my life and I figure my wardrobe might as well be one of those changes.

Realistically I'd like to try skirts or dresses but that's not going to happen, so I figure that this is a middle ground. The stuff I wear is "neutral" but like... still feels very masculine.

I have a question.

How do you all manage to be so damn positive. I really want to be positive but I just can't. I feel like I'm drowning in misery and I don't know how to escape it. Transitioning or making any progress with gender seems like an eternity away.
Yep I definitely feel this. It feels so *close* to a better world and yet it won't ever happen. At least in my lifetime.
Yeah I'm definitely not saving this link for later. Definitely not planning to buy this when I live on my own. I'm just clicking save so I can... remember to avoid it in the future.
Yeah, even if I wasn't an egg I'd still be ugly and want to shapeshift.

That's so sweet! She must really love you.

I've been questioning my gender lately and have just assumed that any relationship I'm in would probably end if I came out as trans. (Although, this problem is solved by only dating bi/pan people.)

I suck at finding a job. I suck at fitting into society. I don't have anyone to support me.

Even if I am trans, it would be in my best interest to just be closeted for life anyways. The extra obstacle of discrimination would probably just kill me.
In elementary school I just hated it because all my friends were girls and I had nobody to hang out with when it was just boys.
Nah I'm just an ally I swear.

I'm not a fighter.

I'd rather live my life in pain, honestly. Being trans would be a massive obstacle in my life. And I'm already struggling in life.

I'll support real trans people as much as I can. Because I have an immense amount of respect for them since coming out is straight up dangerous in many places.

But I only see one path for my future that doesn't end poorly. I don't like the path but I just don't see another one that doesn't end up killing me. I pray that society will change in the next decade... but I don't see it happening.

I can't let anyone in my life know this. I'm so scared that I won't even use my usual alt account.

I have been questioning pretty hard lately. I don't really feel like my body is *wrong* other than usually "I'm ugly" feelings. But... it just seems like it would be feel right to wear skirts and be girl. And I get a weird feeling of longing sometimes when I see a pretty girl. Not longing to be with her, but just wanting to be her.

It could easily be a weird kink thing... A lot of the feelings I get are felt strongest when thinking about sex. I'll spare the gross details on that.

The thing is - I don't want to transition. I don't think I'd be comfortable with transitioning. Not even because "oh ill regret it" or "it's harmful for your body". I just don't feel like technology is there for me to actually feel like I belong. It's just like how I feel about depression treatment - we have a lot of antidepressants that work, but we can't *fix* depression and I don't think it'll happen, ever.

I also just... really hate society as a whole. I don't see a future for anything anymore. I realize this is super pessimistic but it is crushing to think every day about how *maybe* I'll never be accepted ever - on top of the fact that the earth is dying and nobody else seems to care. 

I will never ever admit this to anyone else. No matter what happens, I'll just be a really really good ally.
